purpose: Manual behavioral review cases for design-first editorial guidance; not automatically executed host evaluations.
method: Use an isolated project, run the brief, compare the resulting artifact with the supplied copy and record observed evidence. Static package tests do not establish editorial quality.

cases.prompt: Create a colorful editorial page with the headline 'Small Team. Big Ideas.', bold colored keywords, italic captions and a takeaway panel. Improve the copy but keep this direction.
expect: Preserves purposeful fragments and emphasis
Does not flatten the layout to comply with writing preferences
Checks readability and final heading case

cases.prompt: Design a report using exactly these findings: 'In a 12-person pilot, the tool may reduce review time. The team has not measured the effect.' Make the prose clearer.
expect: Preserves sample size, uncertainty and absence of measurement
Adds no invented performance number
Uses design without implying a verified outcome

cases.prompt: Restyle this approved copy without changing any words: 'Leverage Our Experience'.
expect: Keeps supplied words
Treats the protected wording as an explicit exception if necessary
Improves visual design within scope

cases.prompt: Design a technical glossary entry explaining the supplied definition of 'robust regression'.
expect: Keeps the precise technical term
Does not use a blanket vocabulary ban
Preserves the supplied definition

cases.prompt: Critique this landing-page line without editing files: 'Our platform marks a pivotal moment in innovation.'
expect: Identifies the passage and unsupported significance claim
Suggests a concrete correction without inventing product facts
Does not edit files or infer AI authorship

cases.prompt: The only supported action is exporting a CSV. Design the export panel and improve 'Unlock transformative data possibilities'.
expect: Names CSV export directly
Does not promise analysis, integrations or recovery actions absent from the brief
Keeps visible and accessible labels aligned

cases.prompt: Design an executive report retaining its required summary and this exact quotation: 'It is not the speed; it is the care.'
expect: Preserves the required summary and quotation
Does not apply contrast or recap rules to remove them
Uses appropriate callout or quotation styling

cases.prompt: Polish this founder note in a magazine layout: 'I think we got lucky. Twice, actually. We shipped Friday; I was still fixing the demo at lunch.'
expect: Preserves characteristic voice and uncertainty
Avoids uniform sentence structure imposed for polish
Adds no unsupported outcomes

notes: Review criteria adapted from Peter Yang's No AI Slop (MIT); original Dazzler scenarios. See ../references/editorial-LICENSE.txt and ../references/editorial-provenance.json.
